what: Urban centres — the built-up area of a city, where OpenStreetMap's own boundary for it is a metropolitan region instead. Used only when that boundary is too large to be a city; see cityTooBig in qasr.js.
source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS 2021 Urban Centres and Localities (UCL). https://geo.abs.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/ASGS2021/UCL/ Licensed CC BY 4.0. Retrieved 8 September 2026.
